# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/license_inventory.py from docs/compliance/license_inventory.json. Do not edit. -->

The MIT `LICENSE` covers Builder code, not third-party packages or provider data.
Each bundled component keeps its own terms. Dataset attribution is separate from
this software notice and must be checked for each published dataset.

This inventory is not a legal conclusion. A package is `recorded` only when its
installed locked version declares a plainly permissive identifier. Other or
missing declarations need maintainer review, including whether a license requires
attribution, source access, or other distribution steps.

not relicensed by the code license. Fonts and icons: none are tracked here
(checked by the inventory gate).

## Container inputs

The image copies this notice into `/app`. Its Python environment installs the
runtime, `publish` and `auth` extras by default. The Debian base is patched by
`apt-get upgrade`, so the tag alone cannot state exact OS package versions.
A built-image SBOM and Debian copyright files need inspection before closing
the container portion of the audit.
